purpose.zh: 练托马斯侧撑定格的支撑力量
purpose.en: Build support strength for the flare side hold.

text.zh: 同侧手和下方脚撑地，身体接近水平
text.en: Support on the same-side hand and bottom foot with your body nearly horizontal

text.zh: 上方腿抬起，另一只手臂向上伸
text.en: Lift your top leg and reach your free arm up.

text.zh: 撑地手推地，肩远离耳朵
text.en: Push the floor away and keep your shoulder away from your ear.

commonErrors.en: Letting the shoulder sink toward the ear.

cautions.zh: 手腕热身后再做；腕部或肩部疼痛时缩短时间或改简单版本
cautions.en: Warm up your wrists first; if your wrists or shoulders hurt, shorten the hold or use an easier version.
